notes: Menu shortcuts are handled natively across every platform, and the web inspector is no longer reachable in the shipped app (tinyjs 0.37).

win.notes: Ctrl+P opens Open Quickly instead of the webview’s print sheet. Windows also catches up to the 0.1.8 feature set: Page View and page breaks, undo/redo rework, per-folder sessions, Markdown flavor toggles, search pins, image templates, the nib terminal command (File ▸ Install ‘nib’ Shell Command…), and a reorganized menu bar — the new Preview menu holds everything about how the document renders.
